exposure: loss of the retroplacental clear space at US
focal interruption of the myometrial border
cohort: 171 patients with placenta previa from two institutions
finding: A nomogram incorporating maternal smoking history, number of previous cesarean sections, loss of the retroplacental clear space on ultrasound, and intraplacental dark bands, focal interruption of the myometrial border, and placental bulging on MRI can effectively predict PAS in patients with placenta previa.
mod_finding: The number of previous cesarean sections was a clinical risk factor included in a model predicting placental accreta spectrum in patients with placenta previa.
